tools.name: get_verified_offer
tools.description: Read-only golf-offer.v1 using Chip's admission, exact-variant and live redirect gate. Requires a known 27aDay marketplace deal/product source UUID; search_products returns canonical IDs, not these source IDs. Explicit variant_id null means no selectable variant. Returns verified_offer, check_price o

tools.name: get_verified_offers
tools.description: Discover admitted marketplace sources for a canonical product ID from search_products, then verify each returned offer through Chip's exact-source commerce gate. If variant_id is omitted or null on a variant-bearing product, returns selection_metadata_not_offer options; unsourced specs stay unknown.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the canonical golf equipment catalog by brand, category, or free text. Call this first to resolve a product_id for the other tools. Categories: drivers, iron-sets, wedges, putters, fairway-woods, hybrids, balls, bags, shoes, gloves, apparel, headcovers, complete-sets, accessories, tech, range

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product plus its enrichment_sources provenance rows. Every enriched field carries the source URL, confidence and checked_at it came from. Check enrichment_status before relying on specs: 'enriched' means model, release_year, msrp, description and specs are all sourced; 'partial' means some are m

tools.name: get_current_prices
tools.description: Latest stored advertised prices for one canonical product, with stock observations and stored affiliate links. These are not exact-variant verified buyable offers; use get_verified_offer when a marketplace source ID is known.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily price snapshot series per retailer. Snapshots run unbroken across retailers, so this answers whether a discount is genuine rather than a marked-up list price.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Current retailer prices for one product plus min, max and median, and the 30 and 90 day lows. The single call to answer 'is this a good price right now'.
